title: A great deal of effort and a large number of people
pt: Foco da aula: a great deal of / a large number of / a majority of

lines.en: Tamara, this fair is huge! A large number of people came out today, and you can tell a great deal of effort went into the stands.
lines.pt: Tamara, esta feira está enorme! Um grande número de pessoas veio hoje, e dá para ver que muito esforço foi dedicado às barracas.

lines.en: I know! Most of the visitors seem to be local families, and they're spending money at every stall. Did you see the line for the pretzels?
lines.pt: Eu sei! A maioria dos visitantes parece ser de famílias locais, e todo mundo está gastando em todas as bancas. Você viu a fila dos pretzels?

lines.en: I did. The committee got dozens of vendor applications, but they could only accept about thirty. It took weeks to choose.
lines.pt: Vi. O comitê recebeu dezenas de pedidos de vendedores, mas só pôde aceitar uns trinta. Levaram semanas para escolher.

lines.en: That explains the variety. Variety matters more than quantity, I guess. Instead of fifty cookie stands, there's pottery, honey, even handmade guitars.
lines.pt: Isso explica a variedade. Acho que variedade importa mais que quantidade. Em vez de cinquenta bancas de biscoito, tem cerâmica, mel, até violões artesanais.

lines.en: Exactly, and the majority of the committee wanted local products only. A great deal of time was spent choosing, but it paid off.
lines.pt: Exato, e a maioria do comitê queria só produtos locais. Muito tempo foi gasto escolhendo, mas valeu a pena.

lines.en: Is it true that the profit goes to the school? Or is that just a rumor somebody started?
lines.pt: É verdade que o lucro vai para a escola? Ou isso é só um boato que alguém inventou?

lines.en: It's true. Most of the profit is promised to the library, which is being repaired, so every ticket you spend really helps.
lines.pt: É verdade. A maior parte do lucro é prometida à biblioteca, que está em reforma, então cada ingresso que você gasta ajuda de verdade.

lines.en: Then I'm buying more tickets. Lots of my coworkers said they'd come if somebody invited them, so I'll send a message tonight.
lines.pt: Então vou comprar mais ingressos. Vários colegas meus disseram que viriam se alguém os convidasse, então vou mandar uma mensagem hoje à noite.

lines.en: Please do! Last year only a small number of them showed up, because the advertising started way too late.
lines.pt: Por favor! No ano passado só um pequeno número deles apareceu, porque a divulgação começou tarde demais.

lines.en: This time the posters went up early. A couple of neighbors told me they'd already heard about it from their kids.
lines.pt: Desta vez os cartazes foram colados cedo. Alguns vizinhos me disseram que já tinham ouvido falar pelos filhos.

lines.en: Great. Let's walk around before it gets crowded, and then we can count how many people are waiting at the gate.
lines.pt: Ótimo. Vamos dar uma volta antes que lote, e depois podemos contar quantas pessoas esperam no portão.

facts.sub: a great deal of, a large number of, the majority of.

facts.label: a large number of + plural
facts.sub: Use a large number of com substantivos contáveis no plural: a large number of people, vendors, tickets. O verbo concorda com o plural: A large number of vendors asked for a place.

facts.label: a great deal of + incontável
facts.sub: Use a great deal of com incontáveis: a great deal of money, time, effort. Não use com people ou vendors. A great deal of effort went into the stands.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: A great deal of is used with uncountable nouns.
items.why: Yes: a great deal of money.

items.s: We say “a great deal of people”.
items.why: We say a large number of people.

items.s: A majority of means most of a group.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: A great deal of is used with uncountable nouns. → Verdadeiro (Yes: a great deal of money.)
We say “a great deal of people”. → Falso (We say a large number of people.)
A majority of means most of a group. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A busy neighborhood fair · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a warm Saturday in Miami. Alma arrives early at the neighborhood fair. Colorful stands fill the street near the school. Music comes from a small stage in the corner. Ben meets her at the entrance. Together they begin to look around.

“Ben, this fair is huge. A large number of people came, and a great deal of effort went into the stands.” says Alma. “The majority of the visitors are local families, and a great deal of money is being spent at the stalls.” says Ben. “A large number of vendors asked for a place, but the organizers could only accept a small number of them.” says Alma.
